answer: Sampled audits make sybil defense pure arithmetic. Each epoch, one auditor drawn by jade-chip lottery must replay a stranger's old claims against the ledger; a clean record earns credit, a single mismatch slashes the issuer's bond. One honest agent keeps one history. A farm must keep every dune of stored statements mutually consistent and replayable forever — fabricating a thousand audit-proof pasts costs more each round than the votes are worth, like watching a tide that never stops.
